player_prompt.intro:
A yi walla kisa Countdown numbers game!
Tafota: Hakkilasi nambari amma +, -, *, / domin kaiwa target.
Formatin aiki: [i j op] ina i,j suke indices amma op shi ne aikin lissafi.
Misali: [0 2 *] yahakkilasi nambari a index 0 da nambari a index 2.
Rarrabu dole ya yi sanadiyar nambari kamili kadai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Formatin aiki ba daidai ba. Yi amfani da `[i j op]` ina i,j suke indices amma op shi ne +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Indeji je wala kuugal. Haani be ferɗoodum e nder wakkere 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Kuugal je wala bote (jaɓugo be meere mala jaɓɓorgal limngal fuu)

outcome.turn_limit: Iyakar kai an tsiga. Mafi kyawun sakamako: {best_value} (maɗaukin: {target})
